name: Zephaniah
lede: The thirty-sixth book of the Bible, in full: the word of Jehovah which came unto Zephaniah in the days of Josiah — the great day of Jehovah is near, a day of wrath, a day of darkness and gloominess; seek ye Jehovah, all ye meek of the earth; woe to the oppressing city; and sing, O daughter of Zion, for Jehovah thy God is in the midst of thee — every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: The Great Day of Jehovah
books.blurb: I will utterly consume all things from off the face of the ground; them that worship the host of heaven upon the housetops; hold thy peace, for the day of Jehovah is at hand; I will search Jerusalem with lamps; the great day of Jehovah is near, a day of darkness and gloominess, a day of the trumpet and alarm; seek ye Jehovah, all ye meek of the earth; Gaza forsaken, Moab as Sodom, Nineveh a desolation; woe to the oppressing city; and sing, O daughter of Zion — he will rejoice over thee with joy, he will joy over thee with singing.
